A lot of the time, a bad guy with a gun is stopped by a good guy with a gun. Many people even argue that guns save far more lives than they harm. In one recent incident, a father in Bend, Oregon, did just that when he stopped a school shooter because he was a good guy with a gun in the right place and at the right time. This is what makes it bizarre, to say the least, that the Portland City Council has approved a resolution that bans good guys with guns.
title: Portland City Council Bans Guns At City Hall Following School Shooting Where Good Guy With A Gun Saved Lives
